# Exercise 1: Body mass estimation using vectorization vs. for loop

Vectorization and loops can perform repeated operations in R. For example, `x + y` adds corresponding elements of two vectors. A loop can produce the same result one element at a time:

```{r}
x <- c(1, 2, 3)
y <- c(4, 5, 6)

z <- NULL
for (i in seq_along(x)) {
  z <- c(z, x[i] + y[i])
}
z
```

<br>
